notes.title: The Time Trials Hotfix (& Completion Guide)
notes.notes:
This hotfix makes it so the Steam Achievements for The Time Trials are now properly hooked up! There was a massive oversight on my part, and I failed to fill in key information into a specific file for it to work. The 4 new achievements should now be achievable! I'm really sorry to those of you who put in the work to beat all the races, only to find that you didn't get the achievement. 
Also, I [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3349255040]posted a Guide[/url] with a breakdown of how to get 100% on your save-file.

notes.title: The Time Trials
notes.notes:
Do you have what it takes to earn the title of Fastest in the Sky? In each level, you can find several races to test your flight skills. Faster times earn more stars!
This update also brings some quality-of-life changes and general bugfixes.
We're also happy to provide the game in Spanish and Portuguese now too!

Get out there and see what you've got!

notes.title: The Countdown to the Sequel Begins: Celebrate with a Discount on the First Game!
notes.notes: It’s been a little while since we launched Jasper Vice: Legends Untold. Now we’re kicking into gear and beginning work on the sequel! In it, Jasper continues his training to become one of the elite Voyagers. To celebrate our start of production, we decided to put the OG game on sale, hoping that more of you will be able to enjoy it and give us feedback to make the next one even better!

notes.title: Small Patch
notes.notes: Hey all! Hope you're enjoying the game. This is just a small patch to correct a few lines of dialogue we came across that weren't how they should have been. ;)

notes.title: Jasper Vice is Live on Steam!!!
notes.notes:
It's been a crazy few years making this thing, and it's just the first step of a much larger journey. I feel a strong connection with Jasper as he's going through the initial entry tests to join the Voyagers. All the questions he's asking himself and the challenges he's overcoming mirror in many ways my own journey as a game developer. There are puzzles to solve, there are truths to discover, there is knowledge to be gained, and you can't do it all in the safety of a classroom.

I hope that something about this game connects with people, and sparks a longing in their hearts to do more, be more, dare more, live and love more.

All that said, I hope you enjoy the journey.
